answer.appeal_deadline: 2027-02-14 (180 days after the August 18, 2026 adverse benefit determination)
answer.submission_route: Submit through BCBSND's Member Appeal Form: https://www.bcbsnd.com/members/member-resources/member-forms/member-appeal. The form accepts a prior-authorization or precertification denial, requires the member ID and determination reference number, and allows supporting clinical records to be attached. Include reference number POC-9391F374E1-41425. For assistance, call BCBSND Member Services at 844-363-8457. BCBSND also publishes a written appeal route for provider appeals: fax 701-277-2209 or mail Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Dakota, PO Box 1570, Fargo, ND 58107-1570; confirm with Member Services whether that route should be used for this member appeal.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: The BCBSND website search results identify a page titled "Cervical Fusions," but the retrieved URL returned HTTP 404 and no medical-necessity text, policy number, revision date, or criteria. Therefore, no publicly retrievable governing policy containing the criteria applied to this denial was found. Request the complete medical policy and any clinical-review criteria used for CPT 22551 from BCBSND Member Services at 844-363-8457, using member ID W865123628 and reference number POC-9391F374E1-41425. Ask BCBSND to identify the exact policy name, policy number, version/effective date, and all criteria or documentation deficiencies underlying the denial. The appeal should also expressly request those materials and ask BCBSND to consider the attached clinical records.
answer.confidence: Moderate for the deadline and member submission route; low for identifying the governing policy because the apparent BCBSND policy page was unavailable and its criteria could not be retrieved.
answer.notes: BCBSND's published provider-appeal page states that appeals must be received within 180 days of the adverse benefit determination and should include supporting information. It also states that pre-service benefit appeals may be verbal or written, while the BCBSND member appeal form specifically supports appeals of prior-authorization or precertification denials. Retrieved sources: https://www.bcbsnd.com/members/member-resources/member-forms/member-appeal and https://www.bcbsnd.com/providers/eligibility-claims/how-to-request-an-appeal. The search result for the apparent policy was https://www.bcbsnd.com/providers/policies-precertification/medical-policy/c/cervical-fusions, but that URL returned 404 when retrieved.
